title: GrowWithHR OSHWC Wave 5F Governed Source-Readiness Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR OSHWC bounded Central/Maharashtra source-identity snapshot
sourcePack.notes: The existing Code and Central Rules registrations are reused from Wave 5A. Wave 5F adds direct official commencement and Maharashtra draft-rule source identities. The Maharashtra rule sets remain draft-only; exact controlled full-file Drive mirrors and any final State rules remain pending.

limitations: The Wave 5F catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not an applicability, establishment-classification, registration/licensing, safety-standard, working-condition, inspection, penalty, prosecution or remedy determination.

Only organisation-level source route, source-readiness, draft-final reconciliation, generic establishment-control and specialist-escalation statuses plus controlled references are eligible for retrieval context.

Retrieval cannot treat a draft State rule as final, infer a customer classification or worker threshold, decide Chapter XI special-category duties, process individual incidents or change the deterministic decision.

chunks.title: OSHWC application and generic establishment boundary
chunks.text: The controlled OSHWC Code source identifies commencement, application and core definitions. Wave 5F records a bounded Central or Maharashtra candidate source route only and does not decide whether the Code applies to a customer or classify an establishment.

chunks.title: Registration and employer-duty source boundary
chunks.text: The Code contains establishment registration and employer or employee duty provisions. Wave 5F reviews organisation-level source controls only and cannot decide registration liability, worker counts, appointment-letter sufficiency, medical duties, accident-reporting sufficiency or customer compliance.

chunks.title: Core safety, health, welfare and working-condition source boundary
chunks.text: The Code contains occupational safety and health, working-condition, welfare, hours and leave, records, inspector and employment-of-women provisions. Wave 5F uses those chapters only as generic source-readiness context and does not select standards, calculate working hours or leave, validate night-work conditions, penalties or enforcement.

chunks.title: Current Central Rules source boundary
chunks.text: The official Central Rules were notified as G.S.R. 345(E) on 8 May 2026 and state that they come into force on publication. Wave 5F records the Central Rules source and generic control readiness only; it does not determine whether Central rules rather than State rules govern a customer.

chunks.title: Central legacy-rule transition boundary
chunks.sectionReference: G.S.R. 345(E) preamble — supersession subject to savings
chunks.text: The Central Rules supersede listed legacy Central rules subject to savings for matters already done or omitted. Wave 5F treats that as transition-source context only and does not resolve State-rule savings, customer-specific transition or pending proceedings.

chunks.title: OSHWC commencement context
chunks.text: The official commencement notification appoints 21 November 2025 as the date on which the OSHWC Code provisions come into force. Retrieval cannot turn commencement context into customer applicability or a substantive compliance conclusion.

chunks.title: Maharashtra Labour draft-rules boundary
chunks.text: The Maharashtra Labour Department published the Maharashtra OSHWC (Labour) Rules, 2026 as draft rules for objections and suggestions. They are retained only as a draft State source identity and cannot be treated as final, operative or sufficient to decide customer duties.

chunks.title: Maharashtra Factories and Other Ports draft-rules boundary
chunks.text: The Maharashtra Labour Department published the Maharashtra OSHWC (Factories and Other Ports) Rules, 2026 as draft rules. They are retained only as a draft State source identity and cannot classify a customer as a factory or port or supply final operative requirements.

chunks.title: Maharashtra draft-versus-final reconciliation control
chunks.sectionReference: Draft pre-publication notice and State rules register
chunks.text: Wave 5F requires a separate draft-versus-final reconciliation control. A later final Maharashtra instrument must be independently acquired, fingerprinted and approved before the product may represent any draft text as operative.

chunks.title: Deferred Chapter XI and special-category boundary
chunks.text: Contract labour, inter-State migrant worker, mines, building and other construction work and other special categories require later bounded packs. Wave 5F cannot decide those classifications and preserves separate EPF and ESI source-routing dependencies.
